notes.title: Peer-to-Peer Tutorial
notes.content:
The game servers will be closing on March 1st, making the game playable for free in peer-to-peer only by this date. To help you with the P2P switch, we have planned a complete tutorial and Q&A for the ones who might face difficulties.
[h3]HOW CAN I CREATE A PRIVATE LOBBY?[/h3]
When the game lands in the lobby, click on [b]« PLAY »[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/fef8ee35c07bd7b2d8897178ebff6f31c0cf94ff.png[/img]
Click on [b]"CUSTOM"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/270b9b5dcc31deb0b6a035ead1fcf1e59f9bf86a.png[/img]
Then click on [b]"CREATE"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/b66f9b30b6dd463f2d490e1738018b4db8d3de00.png[/img]
You should land in your [b]private lobby.[/b] Share your IP address with your friend(s) wanting to join. If you don't know what your IP address is, we suggest you to look on the internet. Please use a channel you consider safe before sharing it to others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/f29ca6a8fcf10a7f186ccaac710aa350d42b3a25.png[/img]
Wait for other players to join the lobby then customize the match as you want!
[h3]IF YOUR FRIEND(S) ARE FACING A LOG ERROR[/h3]
The most probable cause of this comes from the 7777-default port number that is used by the game. It can happen that the 7777 port is already used by some other software (such as another online video game!)
[olist]
[*] We recommend the host checks which vacant ports they have, and choose a different one. 
[*] Restart the lobby and enter the new port in the [b]CREATE [/b]info bar
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/58a013e2b447c888f00ec586c0fa3e8fffcc836b.png[/img]
You should land in your private lobby, now you can share the port number with your friends wanting to join.

NOTE: the host doesn't need to have anything set up on their computer or game, but they must share their IP address AND the chosen vacant port to everyone who wants to join. This is the standard way of sharing this information:  

[b]Host_IP_address:Host_Port_Number[/b]

If we take a fictional IP address and the port 11 000 for example:

[b]192.168.45.78:11000[/b]
[h3]HOW CAN I JOIN MY FRIEND'S LOBBY?[/h3]
[olist]
[*] When the game lands in the general lobby, click on « PLAY »
[*] Click on "CUSTOM"
[*] Then go on « JOIN » category and look for the search bar
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/ab7bdff58712994395c4da97047d273f065d4dd1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Insert the host's IP address.
[*] Click on [b]"JOIN"[/b]
[*] You should land in the host's private lobby! Enjoy
[/list]
[h3]IF YOU CANNOT FIND THE HOST'S LOBBY[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Re-start steps 1 and 2. Then, wait for the host to share you a new port number.
[*] When received, look for the search bar and insert host's IP address + shared port number such as: Host_IP_address:Host_Port_Number. If we take a fictional IP address and the port 11 000 for example: 192.168.45.78:11000
[*] Now you should find the host's private match correctly, enjoy!
[/olist]
[h3]Q & A[/h3]
[b]Do I have to pay for BCA as it is out of Early Access?[/b]

No, BCA is out of Early Access with the 1.0 Update, but the game is still free.

[b]Do I need to download anything to make peer-to-peer work?[/b]

No, P2P system is a native feature you can find on any computer nowadays. BattleCore Arena just uses it to connect players between each other.

[b]Is matchmaking still going to be available?[/b]

On 1st of March 2025, servers will be taken out of service and the peer-to-peer feature will be the only option to connect with other players.

[b]Why can't I join my friend's private lobby?[/b]

In 99% of cases, it is due to the default network port of BCA, the 7777 port. Ask the match's host to give you a vacant port number to be able to join him.

notes.title: BattleCore Arena 1.0
notes.content:
BattleCore Arena is exiting Early Access with a final update. We have an exciting new artistic direction for the interface, and plenty of new, free, things for you.  

While the matchmaking servers will close on the 1st of March, this doesn't mean the end for BattleCore Arena! We will be implementing a P2P solution for which a tutorial will be released to let you know how to connect with friends and continue playing the game. 

There will be a daily play reward to unlock fresh and unseen customization options in the game. 138 items will be unlocked in this manner, and once all of those have been made possible to unlock, the list will start over, so you’ll be able to get anything you missed the first time it was available. 

This will be the final available content for the game: 

[h3]Game modes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Backup 3v3 
[*] Q-Ball 
[/list]
[h3]Arenas [/h3]
[list]
[*] Trinity Island 
[*] Lost Complex 
[*] Singularity 
[*] Shroomworld 
[*] Twilight Path 
[/list]
[h3]The shop  [/h3]
[list]
[*] XP boosts, item packs and founder packs will be removed from the game 
[*] 20% overall discount 
[/list]
See you in the arena!

notes.title: [REPLAY] Major Update livestream
notes.content:
Come and watch Chris and Romain to discover the fresh Major Update of BattleCore Arena!

Your favorite free-to-play platformer shooter has been on since June and you’ve been asking us for two main things: controller support and a faster way to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/d91a6e320e570dd9414964f0bb4c884e9ca1853c.png[/img]

[h3]Quick Play[/h3]
You want to jump into the action? Fast? Quick Play is there for you! Join the first game available across our two game modes and compete against other players:

[b]Backup[/b]: Be the last team standing in this 3V3 Team Death Match where you share lives with your teammates.
[b]Q-Ball[/b]: Enter the highly competitive Q-Ball mode, where teamwork is key to catch and keep the Q-Ball to lead your team to victory.

[h3]Controller support[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/55a98f707d008d6648d78604328e868ede513928.jpg[/img]
You’re not a mouse and keyboard addict? No problem! BattleCore Arena is now compatible with Xbox controllers.

A few options will be available:
[list]
[*] Joysticks deadzone (slider)
[*] X & Y sensitivities (slider)
[*] Horizontal & vertical axis inversion (on/off)
[*] Aim friction (on/off): when controlling the camera, cross hair will slow down when passing on a target.
[*] Aim response curve (Classic, Linear, Fine aim, Steady, High Velocity)
[/list]


[h3]New equipment[/h3]
But wait there’s more! We’re also adding three new equipments to enhance your gameplay experience:

[b]NOVA[/b]: Finally, a new weapon to compete against the ORION! Load your projectiles to fire powerful shots.
[b]Black Hole[/b]: Playing with gravity is now within your reach! Launch a black hole that draws in any enemies within its range and shoot at them when they’re trapped.
[b]Synchronization[/b]: After a few times using your ability, you will be able to use it twice in a row!
 

And now, time to get back to the (BattleCore) Arena!

notes.title: 0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello players,

Welcome to our new 0.1.6 hotfix!
Blette has moved again, will you be able to find her now?

[h1]QUICKPLAY[/h1]
Our matchmaking has been reworked into a quickplay set-up. To search for a match, you will no longer need to select a specific game mode queue. Instead, the matchmaking will look for the first available match regardless of the game mode. The "PLAY" UI has been modified to accommodate the reworked matchmaking feature.
 
This also meant that the Q-Ball game mode needed to be been taken off the progression system. If you already unlocked Q-Ball, you will be compensated with 100 Battlecoins when you log in.


[h2]BALANCING[/h2]
The Invisibility has been fixed, resulting in a improvement of the ability:
[list]
[*] The Jump visual effect is now invisible for enemies if you're invisible
[*] If someone is targetting you with another ability while you're invisible, the related visual effects will also be invisible (Shield Healing, Blast, Flashbang)
[/list]
Time to show your sneaky playstyle! 😼
 
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players will now always match against AIs on their first match after completing the tutorial. This is part of our current effort to improve the player onboarding.
[*] We improved device detection in the Option/Audio Tab
[*] Bots can now replace players who left an on-going game. That way, it will always be a 3v3 match
[*] Blette’s image has been improved
[/list]
 
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a Custom Game would not be considered an Ongoing Game
[*] Fixed an issue where players wouldn't be able to join a Custom Game mode as a Party
[*] Fixed a small issue with Custom Game mode icons
[*] Fixed an issue where players could hit through surfaces using explosive type weapons
[*] Fixed an issue where the Regeneration module visual effect did not stop when it should
[*] Fixed the sound effect when using an XP boost in the menu
[*] Fixed an issue where Season pass specific challenges would not progress after purchasing a Season Pass
[/list]

See you in the arena!

notes.title: Temporary Controller Workaround
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/b5eb4cca356c33e8bdc84847e32190bd225108fa.png[/img]


This guide works both for Xbox and PS controllers. It will guide you on how to use the settings in Steam to let you use your controller, despite our game not yet supporting it officially.

We need to modify the default input. This is how to do it:

Press Shift + Tab to open the Steam interface and click on the controller icon. 

If the icon is greyed out, make sure your controller is connected. You might need to connect the controller before you launch the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/c079d4219ef8b7aa8164c5290a3c2b6485fe17f9.jpg[/img]

Then you click on "Enable Steam Input"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/c794b38bfebafa232842bd93baac2b83a9bf6675.jpg[/img]

Click on "Edit Layout"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/c553874d8220b48b3ccbf1a61c987fbf66b610f6.jpg[/img]

This will navigate you to a window where you can link your settings however you prefer to set them on your keyboard or controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/51609b8eddf0eaa3d58a64553042862c9116f05e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/8403ff50f4058b8b263068339147b8538a1329b9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/a5c8d09b3172dd1eaeefe462c6f2b5e381f17435.jpg[/img]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]Why are controllers not fully supported in the game yet?[/b]
Having good and efficient controller support is something that takes time to implement properly. We want to make sure to deliver a good first version with the necessary features needed by players (aim assist, menu navigation, etc.). This Steam solution is to be considered as a temporary one, while waiting for the “official” one 😊

[b]What if I play on Epic/Ubisoft Connect?[/b]
Unfortunately, this solution is only available on Steam, as it is a Steam service. For players on Epic Game Store or Ubisoft Connect, they will have to wait for an official release of the controller support.

[b]How do I remap the buttons?[/b]
Look right above, everything is explained in the article itself 😊 It is a straight forward process. If you have any trouble or want more details, please do not hesitate to[url=https://discord.gg/battlecorearena] join the discord[/url] and ask for it

[b]Is there aim assist?[/b]
No. Aim assist requires in engine work to work properly. This solution should be seen as a temporary solution for players that really want to play with a controller, but we are aware of the limitation of this system regarding specific controller features (aim assist and easy menu navigation)

[b]Will it work on the menus?[/b]
Yes. With your right joystick, you will be able to control your mouse and navigate in the menus. To click on an element, you will have to press the button on the controller that is linked to the left mouse button. Everything in-game in terms of menus should be accessible 😊

[b]Are controller players and keyboard & mouse players in the same queues and lobbies?[/b]
Yes. We do not have the option to separate controller and keyboard & mouse players in matchmaking yet.
